ns2:course.label: Electric Propulsion
ns2:course.description: Elements of propulsion as applied to deep space missions; physics of ionized gases; plasmadynamics; electrothermal, electromagnetic, and electrostatic acceleration of gases to high velocity; high-impulse thruster design and performance; and the resistojet, arcjet, ion engine, MPD arc, and plasma gun. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: AE 433.
